item.title: Cosmological Inference with Gravitational-Wave Dark Sirens and 21-cm Intensity Mapping: Forecasts for LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA with MeerKAT and SKAO
item.description: arXiv:2610.31081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) and 21-cm intensity mapping (IM) are emerging as complementary cosmological probes: GWs provide direct luminosity-distance measurements, while neutral-hydrogen (HI) IM traces the matter distribution in redshift space. Their synergy offers a promising avenue for precise measurements of the Hubble constant. item.title: Gravitational Wave Diffractive Images Reveal the Structure of Astrophysical Objects
item.description: arXiv:2610.31441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scattering patterns encode the structure of extended objects, as demonstrated by charged particle scattering on atomic nuclei. Gravitational wave (GW) diffraction offers an analogous probe of otherwise invisible mass distributions. item.title: GWTC-5.0: Updated LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA Catalog sets new records in precision gravitational wave astronomy
item.description: The LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA Collaboration released today a new catalog of gravitational wave events.
